project.description: Same bridge gimle-examples/greeter-load-generator establishes: translates inbound HTTP requests into real ModuleContext#lookupService(OrderCatalog.class) calls, so an external load tool (curl in a loop, hey, wrk -- anything that can hit one HTTP endpoint at a controlled rate) turns into orders-service's own real, worker-reported requestRatePerSecond, the actual signal AutoscaleReconciler reads -- not a synthetic stand-in for it. No Spring, no shading needed: unlike its three siblings this module has no third-party dependency at all.
